## About
Century Roofing and Construction is a local roofing company on Rendon Bloodworth Rd in Fort Worth, and we serve the entire Dallas Fort Worth area. We're not an out of town company chasing a storm. We're here to give you great service for the lifetime of your roof.
Insurance companies are a pain to deal with, so we help you every step of the way. After your claim is filed, we meet with your adjuster and help explain the sometimes confusing paperwork. Reviewers mention the people they worked with by name, like Kevin, Michael McCorkle, Joe Jimenez and Seth.
We're rated 5 stars from 172 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free Roof Inspection: Our qualified roof inspectors will meet you at your convenience and check your roof for possible damage.
- Submit Insurance Claim: We help homeowners with their insurance claims, meet with your adjuster to inspect for damage and help explain the paperwork.
- Roof Replacement: Typical construction time for a roof replacement is 48 hours or less, depending on how big the house is.
- Residential Roofing: Roofing for homes across the Dallas Fort Worth area.
- Commercial Roofing: Roofing for commercial properties.
- Composition Shingle: Available in a wide range of styles and colors.
- Stone Coated Steel: The tank of the roof world, built to stand up to mother nature.
- Clay Tile: Timeless and long lasting, and a good way to add value to your home.

## FAQ
Q: Will you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. After the claim has been filed, we'll meet with your insurance adjuster to inspect your property for damage and help explain the paperwork.

Q: How long does a new roof take to install?
A: Typical install time for a roof is 48 hours. It varies with the size of the house.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We're based in Fort Worth and serve the entire Dallas Fort Worth area.

Q: Do you clean up after the job?
A: One reviewer said the cleanup was spot on, with no trash and no roofing nails left on the ground.
